description: Force /api/*, /admin/* and /vdp/* to Pages Functions. /api/* prevents GET fallthrough to static 404 before the dispatcher. /admin/* routes admin HTML through functions/admin/_middleware.ts so the code-based admin login gate runs (Sam 2026-06-11). /vdp/* runs the legacy DealerCenter VDP resolver (2026-08-10) — DC syndicates /vdp/<DCID>-<stock>/ links to CarGurus and they were all 404ing. Static sub-assets under /_next/* are unaffected.
